Class SoftBody

java.lang.Object
fluid.SoftBody
public class SoftBody extends Object
How a drop looks, ported from the "Fluide 2D" prototype: the drop's centre plays the prototype's point, a body follows it on a soft spring with some grip on the ground, fluid particles slosh around the body and a thread joins the point to the body.

The prototype's values are kept (per frame at 60 fps); its lengths are multiplied by scale, the size of the drop compared to the prototype's.

      public void addField(float[] field, int gridWidth, int gridHeight, int cell, int originX, int originY, AffineTransform deformation, double scale)
      Adds the metaballs to the field sampled at the centre of each cell, the grid starting at (originX, originY) in the world.
      Parameters:
      field - the metaball field, row by row
      gridWidth - width of the grid, in cells
      gridHeight - height of the grid, in cells
      cell - size of a cell, in px
      originX - world x of the grid's first cell
      originY - world y of the grid's first cell
      deformation - squash of the drop, without translation: every metaball is squashed like it
      scale - size of the drop compared to the prototype's
